confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced averages (MyLifeElsewhere, updated Sept 2026), press reports of Florianopolis beach and bar prices, and an Expatistan cappuccino average. No current cafe or wine-list menus were found, so the cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from beer and beach-bar price points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Brazilian coastal resort pricing for July, not from live listings or searches. Dorm and hostel anchors are the least certain; July is low season, but late-July school holidays and summer peaks can raise rates. FX: the 0.6720 figure for 18 Nov 2026 was reported in a third-party summary of the RBA 4 pm observation. I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Florianopolis-specific aggregate data, cross-checked against the reported restaurant premium over the Brazil average (about 15.6%). Accommodation uses a Brazilian coastal resort-city basis for off-peak July, with no city-specific listing checks.
